mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies hang over the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 50 degrees, feeling like 47 degrees under tonight's Third Quarter moon. The International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, though cloud cover will block the view. Expect an overnight low of 50 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona reminds residents that alternate-side winter street parking regulations go into effect from November 20th through April 1st between 1 AM and 6 AM. Additionally, the Verona Water Utility is partnering with HydroCorp to conduct required cross-connection control inspections, so watch your mail for appointment scheduling letters.
Tomorrow, enjoy live music performances at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee Brewing. Looking ahead to next week, trivia lovers can check out Hop Haus Brewing and Paddy Mac's on Tuesday.

In weekly police news, officers responded on Saturday, October 25th to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped for over 20 minutes, where a 40-year-old Verona man was arrested for an O W I first offence.
Culver's is now closed for the night following today's Mint Explosion flavor. Doors open tomorrow at 10:00 AM featuring the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor of the day.
